title: Path-dependent Hamilton--Jacobi equations: Uniqueness results for viscosity solutions defined via families of compact sets
summary: We consider a path-dependent Hamilton--Jacobi equation with coinvariant derivatives over the space of continuous functions. We prove two uniqueness results for viscosity (generalized) solutions defined in terms of coinvariantly smooth test functionals and a dense family of compact subsets of the space of continuous functions. It is assumed that the Hamiltonian is continuous and satisfies a local Lipschitz condition in the functional variable with respect to the supremum norm.
